main_measure.name: t of the slope of excess 10-bar return regressed on forecast, over positive-forecast grid cells
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 with mean excess > 0; reject if slope t <= -2; at least 100 cells

supporting_check.name: mean excess 10-bar return over the same cells above 0

decided_by: a slope t between -2 and 2 is inconclusive.
reading: cells are at positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window with a full 10-bar forward return inside it; each coin's normal drift is the mean of its 10-bar returns over all such cells of all its windows; the regression pools the cells of all coins, and the main measure's value is the slope (excess return per forecast point).
